scenes.title: A Cinderella Story
scenes.summary: Kristina, a former hostess who married the wealthy restaurant owner Dmitry, visits her old friends at work.

scenes.title: Low Revenue
scenes.summary: Dmitry is shocked by the tiny revenue numbers in the financial report and confronts Vika and Viktor.

scenes.title: Lessons in Saving
scenes.summary: While Dmitry enforces strict savings in the kitchen, Max teaches Kostya how to make extra money at the bar.

scenes.title: Expensive Cognac
scenes.summary: At the bar counter, Max shows Kostya another way to make extra money by serving cognac.

scenes.title: Order at the Bar
scenes.summary: At the bar of Claude Monet, Kostya serves a customer their drink and discusses customer service and drinks with his bar colleague.

scenes.title: A Cunning Scheme
scenes.summary: At the bar, Max reveals a dishonest scheme to sell cheap cognac for a thousand rubles. Kostya protests that the law strictly forbids such deception.

scenes.title: The Greedy Owner
scenes.summary: Owner Dmitry Nagiyev enforces extreme austerity by turning off dining room lights and demanding cheap meat. Chef Viktor directly confronts him over his absurd frugality.

scenes.title: A Common Enemy
scenes.summary: Exasperated by Nagiyev's irrational cost-cutting measures, Chef Viktor and Victoria find common ground and agree that they must unite to stop the madness.

scenes.title: Rent
scenes.summary: Max is confused about the rent payment, and someone explains a scheme with cognac.

scenes.title: Bad Fish
scenes.summary: Someone is feeling sick from eating bad fish despite a warning.

scenes.title: We Arrived
scenes.summary: The group arrives and reflects on their recent behavior before meeting someone.

scenes.title: Smart and Beautiful
scenes.summary: Two friends discuss a woman's intelligence and career in the restaurant business.

scenes.title: Poisoned
scenes.summary: Senya is looking very sick after drinking some bad alcohol. Fedya talks to him about his stomach.

scenes.title: Secret Conversation
scenes.summary: Kristina talks with Victoria and Viktor about the restaurant's finances. She asks Victoria to leave them alone.

scenes.title: The Wrong Bottle
scenes.summary: Max discovers Senya was poisoned by their fake cognac. Viktor asks Kostya for a bottle of cognac and accidentally takes the fake one.

scenes.title: The Clumsy Bartender
scenes.summary: Kostya approaches Viktor's table to try and swap the poisoned cognac bottle back. Viktor gets angry and tells him to go away.

scenes.title: Firings
scenes.summary: Nagiyev and Viktor have a heated argument in the office about the restaurant's budget. Nagiyev wants to save money by firing the most expensive kitchen staff.

scenes.title: Bills
scenes.summary: Nagiyev stops Viktor from leaving and tries to convince him that quitting is a terrible idea. He reminds the chef about his heavy financial responsibilities.

scenes.title: Saving on the Bartender
scenes.summary: The austerity measures continue across the restaurant. Nagiyev confronts Kostya the bartender to deliver some bad news.

scenes.title: Farewell
scenes.summary: Nagiyev gathers the kitchen staff to announce the mass firings. Senya and Fedya discuss the depressing situation.

scenes.title: Underfoot
scenes.summary: Max and Kostya sit outside after losing their jobs. They reflect on their failures and try to find some hope for the future.
